Description
The Bank is seeking proposals from qualified, progressive, and innovative
Service Providers to deliver talent, learning and organizational
development services on an as-required basis.  Services may include the
design and delivery of customized facilitation and team effectiveness
engagements, the development and delivery of learning programs and
solutions ranging from off-the-shelf to fully customized offerings, and
strategic human resources, talent management, and organizational
development consulting services.
